name: Denver Chess Club
note: Colorado's oldest and largest chess club. Hosts USCF-rated tournament games every Tuesday night with monthly tournaments offering classical play.

name: Learn to Play Chess! Meetup
note: Open, friendly chess group offering beginner lessons and casual games at multiple Denver locations. Meetups happen throughout the week at various venues.

name: Rook
note: A rooftop bar and board game lounge in RiNo featuring chess, pool, and other games alongside cocktails. Strategy meets shenanigans in this casual clubhouse atmosphere.

name: Oprah's Rook Club at The Lodge at Woods Boss Brewery
note: A casual chess group that meets every Wednesday night at Woods Boss Brewery's Lodge space. Social, unrated games for all skill levels.

name: Long Table Brewhouse
note: A brewhouse in Park Hill where casual chess players gather. Non-Meetup group plays informally Wednesday and Friday afternoons.

name: Austin Chess Club
note: Meets Saturdays 3pm-9pm at Upbring School. Offers both casual play and USCF-rated tournaments in separate rooms.

name: Pease Park Chess Club
note: Free casual chess meetup on Saturdays 1pm-4pm at Pease Park. Tournament play starts at 1:30pm, free to attend with no membership required.

name: Chess IRL at Central Machine Works Brewery
note: Community-driven chess meetup at brewery. Meets Sundays at 8pm (some sources indicate 1-3pm). Provides chess sets and clocks; no fees.

name: Traveling Chess Club - Jack and Ginger's
note: Social chess meetup at Irish pub. Meets Tuesdays 6-10pm with free tournament starting at 7pm. Must RSVP, 21+ event.

name: Traveling Chess Club - Mozart's Coffee Roasters
note: Casual chess meetup at lakeside coffee roastery. Boards and pieces provided by Traveling Chess Club. Thursdays for chess social.

name: Traveling Chess Club - Stargazer Bar
note: Chess meetup at bar. Meets Wednesdays 7-10pm for casual and competitive chess for all skill levels.

name: South Austin Senior Activity Center Chess
note: Casual chess for all players. Twice-weekly adult chess meetup on Mondays and Fridays 10am-12pm. Bring your own set and board.

name: Lion's Field Adult Center Chess
note: Adult-only casual chess (18+). Meets Thursdays 5-8:30pm. Bring your own chess set.

name: Austin Grandmaster Chess Academy (AGCA)
note: Premiere chess academy with lessons, tournaments, and camps for all skill levels. Offers coaching, USCF-rated tournaments, and specialized training.

name: Nashville Chess Center
note: A nonprofit chess club offering scholastic programs, tournaments, and casual play. Open Sundays 1-4 PM (scholastic), Mondays 4-10 PM, Thursdays 6-10 PM (casual play), and Fridays (rated quads).

name: Blue Room Chess Club
note: Chess club hosted at The Blue Room bar inside Third Man Records. Players can enjoy chess from 7pm to midnight with cocktails and drinks available.

name: Nashville Public Library Chess Club
note: Chess club at the main library led by Frank and friends. Open to all ages and skill levels, meeting every Thursday (weather permitting).

name: Downriver Chess Club - Turtle Bay
note: Downriver Chess Club meets for tournament play at Turtle Bay. Monday nights feature G/15 rapid tournaments with registration at 6:45 PM and first round at 7:00 PM.

name: Downriver Chess Club - Morning Call
note: Downriver Chess Club meets for tournament play at Morning Call coffee stand. Tuesday nights feature G/90 tournaments with registration at 6:30 PM and pairings at 7:00 PM.

name: Downriver Chess Club - Café Envie
note: Downriver Chess Club meets for G/15 rapid tournaments at Café Envie, a French Quarter coffee and espresso bar. Thursday nights with registration at 6:45 PM.

name: The Chess Cave
note: A small nonprofit chess space in the French Quarter offering free and low-cost chess lessons, books, and art. Founded by Baylee Badawy and the Red Beret Chess Foundation.

name: New Orleans Chess House
note: A chess academy, tournament venue, and social club offering casual play, lessons, camps, tournaments, and a members-only cafe. Hosts Saturday tournaments with registration at 4:50 PM.

name: HNOC Chess Club
note: Historic New Orleans Collection's youth-led chess club blending chess with creative activities and historical research. Meets at various locations including the REACH Center and other historic venues.

name: New Orleans West Bank Chess Club
note: Established in 1977, this club meets every Thursday night at 7:30 PM at Woodland Presbyterian Church. Hosts USCF-rated back-to-back tournaments with G/90+30 time control.

name: Downriver Chess Club
note: Non-profit chess club hosting regular meetups three times a week at different venues (Turtle Bay on Mondays, Morning Call on Tuesdays, Café Envie on Thursdays). Organizes USCF-rated tournaments and larger events.

name: Turtle Bay
note: Bar and restaurant in the French Quarter hosting Downriver Chess Club meetups. Monday nights feature G/15 chess tournaments with registration at 6:45 PM.

name: Café Envie
note: French Quarter café hosting Downriver Chess Club tournaments on Thursday nights. G/15 chess games with registration at 6:45 PM. Public venue with occasional distractions.

name: Morning Call Coffee Stand
note: Historic coffee stand at City Park Area hosting Downriver Chess Club tournaments on Tuesdays. Five-round G/90 tournaments held one round per week over five weeks.

name: HNOC Chess Club (Historic New Orleans Collection)
note: Youth-led chess club blending chess with creative activities and historical research about New Orleans chess heritage. Meets at multiple locations including Royal Street and hosts annual Chess Fest.

name: Greater New Orleans Chess Club
note: Formerly Metairie Chess Club. Hosts Tuesday 5-round G/90 tournaments at Morning Call, one round per week. Offers casual play and skittles anytime.
